lines.text: One character. Every scene. Exactly the same face, every time.
Most tools redraw the character in every shot. The eyes drift, the hair changes, and the story breaks.
Consistency Frame locks the design first: face, proportions, colours, and voice.
Every shot is checked against that one approved reference, before it is ever rendered.
The same character, the same voice. Scene after scene, episode after episode.
One character. One voice. Every scene. That is Consistency Frame.
